name: oauth-flow
actions: (() => { const cb=document.querySelector('#useDefaultOauthCred'); if(cb && !cb.checked) cb.click(); const s=document.querySelector('#scopes'); if(s){ const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/userinfo.email'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); } return JSON.stringify({cb:cb?cb.checked:null,scopes:s?s.value:null,btn:document.querySelector('#authorizeApisButton')?.className}); })()
(() => { const b=document.querySelector('#authorizeApisButton'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; if((b.className||'').includes('disabled')) return 'still-disabled'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

name: google-email
actions: (() => { const i=document.querySelector('#identifierId'); if(!i) return 'no-input'; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(i,'px1.probe.123456789@gmail.com'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x=>(x.innerText||'').trim()==='次へ'); if(!b) return 'no-button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

name: webauthn-register
actions: (() => { const i=document.querySelector('#input-email'); if(!i) return 'no-input'; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(i,'px1-test-20261023'); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return 'filled'; })()
